_about: Verified Wikipedia targets for every observance in the General Roman Calendar (keyed by romcal feast id) and Common Worship (keyed by Anglican day name). Checked by scripts/check_feast_map.py. titles: articles whose first sentences describe the day. For several titles, the display falls back to 'Label: Wikipedia short description.' per person when the sentences don't all fit; labels default to the article titles. text: a written description for observances no article fits, with an optional image article.
